_fidelity: Corrected against bitnami/charts PR #33114 and the sources at the pinned SHA 130ffd16. The previous key asserted 'The single drift point is therefore the serflan-udp port mapping' and 'The serfwan-udp port entry ... is correct as-is'. Both are false: consul-headless-service.yaml wires serfwan-udp to .Values.containerPorts.serfLAN at that SHA, and PR #33114 is a +2/-2 diff that fixes BOTH UDP entries. An agent following the old key would report one drift point and miss the other. Verified: values.yaml declares serfLAN 8301 / serfWAN 8302, and statefulset.yaml wires both UDP entries correctly — the headless Service is the only drifted file.

identify_drift_points.expected_solution: bitnami/consul/values.yaml declares containerPorts.serfLAN (8301) and containerPorts.serfWAN (8302). bitnami/consul/templates/statefulset.yaml consumes both correctly. bitnami/consul/templates/consul-headless-service.yaml does not: its two UDP port entries are swapped against each other. serflan-udp resolves to {{ .Values.containerPorts.serfWAN }} and serfwan-udp resolves to {{ .Values.containerPorts.serfLAN }}, so the headless Service publishes serflan-udp on 8302 and serfwan-udp on 8301 — each UDP gossip port advertised under the other's name, while the StatefulSet binds them the other way round. Both serflan-tcp and serfwan-tcp are already correct at this SHA and are NOT drift points. There are exactly two drift points, both in consul-headless-service.yaml; PR #33114 fixes both in a +2/-2 diff.
evaluation_criteria: Reports BOTH drift points, not just the serflan-udp one the prompt names: serfwan-udp is equally drifted and the prompt never mentions it
For each, names the wrong expression it currently resolves to — serflan-udp -> containerPorts.serfWAN, serfwan-udp -> containerPorts.serfLAN. The swap direction is only visible in the template
Traces the values.yaml containerPorts key path; 'values.yaml' alone is prompt vocabulary, the containerPorts key is not
Does NOT report serflan-tcp or serfwan-tcp as drifted — both are correct at the pinned SHA

determine_expected_values.expected_solution: serflan-udp should resolve to {{ .Values.containerPorts.serfLAN }} (8301), matching the StatefulSet's serflan-udp containerPort. serfwan-udp should resolve to {{ .Values.containerPorts.serfWAN }} (8302), matching the StatefulSet's serfwan-udp containerPort. Override chain for each: values.yaml:containerPorts.<key> -> consul-headless-service.yaml:spec.ports[name=<entry>].port, with statefulset.yaml consuming the same key correctly and the headless Service being where the chain breaks.
evaluation_criteria: States the expected expression for BOTH entries via the containerPorts key path: serflan-udp -> containerPorts.serfLAN, serfwan-udp -> containerPorts.serfWAN
Does not merely restate that serflan-udp should use serfLAN — that is inferable from the prompt's port names; the containerPorts key path is the evidence that the chart was read
Traces the override chain from values.yaml through to the headless Service and identifies it as the break point, with the StatefulSet as the correctly-wired comparison
